name: claude-mods

plugins.name: auto-handoff
plugins.description: Before a long chat is squeezed (compacted), writes a full handoff note and keeps it word for word. /handoff makes one on demand.

plugins.name: second-check
plugins.description: A second AI watches over Claude: flags what an answer missed, and checks anything published or deployed against your rules first. /check reviews the whole chat.

description: Two Claude mods: auto-handoff (nothing lost when a long chat is squeezed) and second-check (a second AI that flags misses and checks publishes against your rules).
